Circle With Vertical Fill Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Circle With Vertical Fill because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+25CD, which you can use as ◍ in HTML, \25CD in CSS, or type with Alt+9677 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Circle With Vertical Fill is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+25CD is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Circle With Vertical Fill has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ◍ or the hex escape ◍.

How to type circle with vertical fill on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 6 7 7 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9677.
  4. Release Alt. The Circle With Vertical Fill character (◍) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type circle with vertical fill on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Circle With Vertical Fill. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Circle With Vertical Fill" and click the character to insert it.

How to use circle with vertical fill in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\25CD"; ()
  • Python: \u25CD or chr(0x25CD)
  • JavaScript: \u25CD or String.fromCodePoint(0x25CD)
  • JSON: "\u25CD"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ◍?

No legacy Alt code exists for Circle With Vertical Fill because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+25CD in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ◍ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ◍, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9677 not work?

Alt+9677 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Circle With Vertical Fill?

The Unicode codepoint for Circle With Vertical Fill is U+25CD. You can use this value in HTML as ◍, in CSS as \25CD, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ◍ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+25CD, then click it.
